G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(g, fill=1):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fgs=set(c)-{bg}
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):
        f=[j for j in range(w) if g[i][j] in fgs]
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==bg and any(x<j for x in f) and any(x>j for x in f): out[i][j]=fill
    for j in range(w):
        f=[i for i in range(h) if g[i][j] in fgs]
        for i in range(h):
            if g[i][j]==bg and any(x<i for x in f) and any(x>i for x in f): out[i][j]=fill
    return out
